app.title: Word Shortcut Builder
app.tagline: Custom Word keyboard shortcuts, ready in one file.

home.title: Build a Normal.dotm with your own Word shortcuts
home.subtitle: Pick commands, press a key combination, and download a ready-to-use template. No server, no account, no macro.
home.startEmptyBody: Open the editor with an empty shortcut list.
home.presetBody: Start from a curated set for academic, publishing, or legal work.
home.presetEmpty: This preset has no shortcuts yet. Preset data is filled from the T4 command catalog.
home.loadBody: Continue from a JSON file you saved earlier.
home.loadError: That file could not be read as a shortcut configuration.
home.loadMissing: {{count}} shortcut(s) reference commands that are not in the catalog and were skipped.
home.privacyTitle: Your files never leave this device
home.privacyBody: Everything is generated in your browser. No configuration or document is uploaded.
home.scopeBody: Windows and macOS, Word 2016, 2019, 2021, and Microsoft 365. Word for the web and mobile are not supported.

editor.title: Shortcut editor
editor.subtitle: Choose a command, then press the keys you want to use.
editor.catalogEmptyBody: Command and Style names must come from the real Word fixtures (task T0) so the generated file opens without repair. Add fixtures and rebuild to populate the catalog.
editor.bindingsEmptyBody: Pick a command from the catalog to assign a key combination.
editor.previewBody: Keys used by your current shortcuts are highlighted.
editor.clearAllConfirm: Remove every shortcut from this configuration?
editor.platformHint: Changing the platform keeps your shortcuts but resets conflict decisions.

shortcut.captureHint: Click the box and press your keys. Press Esc to cancel.
shortcut.invalidNoKey: Choose at least one non-modifier key.
shortcut.invalidCmdOnWindows: Command/Cmd cannot be used on Windows. Use Ctrl instead.
shortcut.invalidKey: This key has no verified Word key code yet. Choose another key.

conflicts.duplicateBody: It is assigned to another shortcut in your list. Choose a different combination or remove the other shortcut first.
conflicts.defaultBody: Word already uses {{combo}} for “{{name}}”. You can overwrite it or choose another combination.
conflicts.browserBody: The browser may not let the editor capture {{combo}}. You can still enter it manually below.
conflicts.invalidPlatformTitle: Shortcut not valid on this platform
conflicts.invalidPlatformBody: Command/Cmd is only available on macOS. Change this shortcut to use Ctrl, or switch the platform back to macOS.
conflicts.summaryBody: Resolve these conflicts before downloading the template.

summary.title: Review and download
summary.subtitle: Check your shortcuts, then download the template file.
summary.warningBody: Installing this file replaces the existing Normal.dotm on that computer. Custom styles, AutoText, and macros in the old file will be lost. Back up the old file first — the installation guide explains how.
summary.emptyBody: Add at least one shortcut in the editor first.
summary.unresolvedBody: Go back to the editor and resolve the highlighted conflicts.
summary.missingTargets: These shortcuts were skipped because their commands are missing from the catalog: {{list}}
summary.fixturesPendingTitle: File generation is waiting for Word fixtures
summary.fixturesPendingBody: The PRD requires the OOXML parts and internal Word names to be transcribed from real Normal.dotm fixtures (task T0). Until that folder is populated, the site will not guess them. You can still save your configuration as JSON.
summary.macPendingTitle: macOS generation needs a Mac fixture
summary.macPendingBody: Shortcuts are verified against the Windows Word 2021 fixture. Command-key encoding on macOS must come from a real Mac Normal.dotm before the site can generate Mac files. You can still configure shortcuts and save the JSON on this platform.

guide.title: Installation guide
guide.subtitle: Follow the steps for your operating system. Close Word before copying the file.
guide.folderProvisional: Verify this path against the T0 human test before publishing.

backup.title: Back up the old Normal.dotm
backup.body: Open the Templates folder, rename the existing Normal.dotm to Normal.backup.dotm, or copy it somewhere safe.

close.title: Close Word completely
close.body: Word keeps the template open in the background. Quit Word, including any documents that are still open.

copy.title: Copy the downloaded file
copy.body: Download Normal.dotm from the summary page, then move it into the Templates folder.

paste.title: Replace the old file
paste.body: Confirm the replacement when your system asks. The file must be named exactly Normal.dotm.

restart.title: Open Word and test
restart.body: Start Word and try one of your shortcuts. If it does not work, check the troubleshooting section below.

guide.unblockBody: Windows may mark downloaded files as unsafe. Right-click Normal.dotm, choose Properties, tick Unblock at the bottom, and click OK. On macOS, remove the quarantine flag if Word refuses to load the file.

troubleItems.blocked: The shortcut does nothing: check that the file is unblocked and that its name is exactly Normal.dotm.
troubleItems.wordOpen: Word was running during installation: quit Word completely and copy the file again.
troubleItems.otherCopy: Another copy wins: search the computer for other Normal.dotm files and keep only the one in the Templates folder.
troubleItems.onedrive: A cloud-synced or redirected profile may use a different Templates folder. Open File > Options > Advanced > File Locations to see the real path.
troubleItems.macPath: On macOS the Templates folder differs between Word versions. Use Word > Preferences > File Locations to confirm it.

guide.warningBody: Replacing Normal.dotm resets custom styles, AutoText, and macros stored in it. Always keep the backup until you have tested the new file.

errors.unknownVersion: This configuration was made by a newer version of the site. Its version is not supported.
errors.invalidConfig: This file is not a valid shortcut configuration.
errors.invalidJson: This file is not valid JSON.
errors.fixturesRequired: File generation is not available until the Word fixtures are installed.
errors.unresolved: Resolve the remaining conflicts before generating the file.
errors.generationFailed: The file could not be generated. Your configuration is still intact.
errors.fileRead: The file could not be read.
errors.missingTargets: Some shortcuts reference commands that are not in the catalog.

footer.privacy: All processing stays in your browser.
footer.noServer: No uploads. No account. No macros.
